posts.author: mike_312
posts.body: Hi everyone, I wanted to know if it is possible to make a skill that gives you a charge as you use it, for example. A skill that when you use it adds 10p to your attack but that is restored and set to 0 at the end of the battle. I know that with variables it could be done but I don't know how to set it to 0 when the battle ends. I use rpg maker mz and I have the visustella plugins.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
You could do it with the
Skills and States Core
I'm sure.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You'd use notetags from the Battle Core.
On the actor:
Code:
<JS Pre-Start Battle>
user.charge = 0;
</JS Pre-Start Battle>
On the skill:
Code:
<JS Post-Damage>
user.charge++;
</JS Post-Damage>
Then you just use
a.charge
in your damage formula.

posts.author: mike_312
posts.body:
It works! Thank you very much.
And how could I change the number of charges that it increases? Because that way it only increases 1 by 1

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body: change user.charge++ to user.charge+=2 or whatever number youd like
